purpose: Fail-closed local preflight before any Google Play screenshot capture. It verifies Android device/emulator readiness, package installation, display metadata and current-only evidence output without mutating Play Console, Supabase or billing.

adb_resolution.root_cause: The original runner trusted PATH as the only ADB authority even when Android Studio/SDK and an emulator were already installed and usable outside PATH.
adb_resolution.prevention: Resolve ADB from PATH, ANDROID_SDK_ROOT, ANDROID_HOME, the standard Windows Android SDK locations under LOCALAPPDATA/USERPROFILE, and Flutter doctor SDK evidence before failing closed.
adb_resolution.regression_guard: CI requires the resolver function and all canonical discovery sources; future refactors cannot silently return to PATH-only discovery.

pass_means: The local Android surface is technically ready for the next controlled real-app screenshot automation step. PASS does not attest store assets, authentication state, screenshot quality or Play publication authority.
